title: melicope remyi
intro: Melicope remyi, commonly known as Ohia, is a plant species endemic to Hawaii, belonging to the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and fight off pathogens. The therapeutic actions of Melicope remyi include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and coumarins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
